title: ChannelFlow-Tools: A Configuration-Driven Pipeline for Generating Machine-Learning-Ready Datasets of 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
abstract: arXiv:2509.15236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data-driven surrogate models are increasingly used in computational fluid dynamics, and their reliability depends on the quality of the training data. These models are typically trained on fixed, pre-generated datasets. Systematic surrogate studies require controlled data generation, in which datasets can be regenerated, adapted, or extended to match specific research requirements. We introduce ChannelFlow-Tools, an open-source, configuration-driven pipeline for generating ML-ready datasets of three-dimensional obstructed channel flows. The pipeline integrates procedural obstacle geometry generation across six shape families, signed-distance-field (SDF) voxelisation, lattice-Boltzmann simulation, and packaging into ML-ready tensors. translated_title: ChannelFlow-Tools：一种配置驱动的流水线，用于生成三维受阻通道流动的机器学习就绪数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.15236v2 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：数据驱动的代理模型在计算流体力学中应用日益广泛，其可靠性取决于训练数据的质量。这些模型通常在固定的、预生成的数据集上进行训练。系统性的代理模型研究需要可控的数据生成，使数据集能够根据具体研究需求重新生成、调整或扩展。我们介绍了ChannelFlow-Tools，一个开源、配置驱动的流水线，用于生成三维受阻通道流动的机器学习就绪数据集。该流水线集成了六种形状族的程序化障碍物几何生成、符号距离场（SDF）体素化、格子玻尔兹曼模拟，以及打包成机器学习就绪张量。工作流程由配置文件驱动，几何生成阶段已验证具有字节级可重复性。该流水线通过全语料库网格完整性审计进行评估，并进一步通过...
tldr: 本文提出ChannelFlow-Tools，一个配置驱动的开源流水线，能够可控地生成、调整和扩展三维受阻通道流动的机器学习数据集，并通过几何生成的可重复性验证和完整性审计确保数据质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChannelFlow-Tools, an open-source configuration-driven pipeline that enables controlled generation, adaptation, and extension of ML-ready datasets for 3D obstructed channel flows, with byte-identical reproducibility in geometry generation and integrity audits ensuring data quality.
